messages:
Riya Shah: Hi all, Riya joining today on Runtime. Need a dev GCP project in europe-west1 and ability to create service accounts. Prefer project named `redwood-riya-dev`. GCP roles: roles/viewer, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser, roles/storage.objectAdmin.

Riya Shah: Also need AWS assume-role access to `arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/Redwood-Dev-APAC` and S3 write to `s3://redwood-dev-artifacts/riya/`. Who handles billing link for EU projects?

Infra Onboarding Bot: Created ticket ONB-8023. Please confirm cost center and if you need long-lived keys.

Owen Brooks: welcome Riya! For billing, include cost center COST-RUNTIME-DEV. We prefer ephemeral SA keys. If you need project created, infra can do it.

Riya Shah: cost center COST-RUNTIME-DEV, ephemeral SA is fine. Just want to run integration tests this week.

Finance Bot: Finance requires estimated monthly spend. Please reply with estimate.

Riya Shah: estimate <$150/mo while testing.

Cloud Platform: Project `redwood-riya-dev-2026` created and linked to BILL-EU-09A1. Granted requested GCP roles to riya.shah@redwood.ai. Ephemeral SA `ci-riya` created with 24h key available in ticket ONB-8023. AWS assume-role trust updated; Owen gave S3 prefix perms.

Owen Brooks: Confirmed S3 Put/Get/List for prefix `redwood-dev-artifacts/riya/`. Try a quick upload and ping if you hit MFA issues.

Riya Shah: Verified both GCP and AWS flows, all good. Thanks!
